answer.origin: NVIDIA Corporation blog post dated 2026-07-01 (party statement, company publisher), with quoted remarks from Sharon AI CEO James Manning and Firmus co-CEO Tim Rosenfield reproduced in the same post.
answer.note: NVIDIA's own statement says it is introducing a business model in which AI clouds procure NVIDIA infrastructure to sell NVIDIA-powered cloud services to AI-native, enterprise and ISV customers, under a revenue-sharing and credit-support structure. NVIDIA says it would earn both standard product revenue and a share of cloud revenue on supported capacity, which it describes as a recurring, usage-linked earnings stream. Conditional on this being implemented as described, it points to a shift in NVIDIA's economics toward participation in downstream cloud revenue and to added demand channels through AI cloud partners. The model is announced, not shown in deal values, volumes or signed contracts. The only quantified item is Firmus's Batam, Indonesia campus, expected to scale to 360 MW and up to 170,000 NVIDIA GPUs; that is a stated project expectation from NVIDIA's post, not a disclosed NVIDIA order or revenue amount. Sharon AI and Firmus statements are supportive but are party quotes with no financial terms.
limitations: No disclosed financial terms, revenue-share percentages, credit-support size or contract values for the NVIDIA model.
The Firmus 360 MW / 170,000 GPU figures are project expectations (scale 'expected to'), with no stated timeline or confirmed financing.
Whether NVIDIA has signed binding agreements with Sharon AI, Firmus or other AI clouds is not disclosed in this source.
No disclosed NVIDIA revenue or order amount attributable to these partners; the source gives no split of product versus cloud-share revenue.
Named AI natives (Baseten, Fireworks AI, Together AI) are cited as demand examples only; no purchase or partnership terms are disclosed for them.
follow_up: Check NVIDIA's next Form 10-Q/10-K or earnings commentary for any quantification of the revenue-sharing or credit-support model and its accounting treatment.
Check for any NVIDIA 8-K, press release or counterparty filing naming signed agreements, credit-support amounts or revenue-share terms with AI cloud partners.
Track Firmus Batam campus progress (power, financing, GPU deployment milestones) through Firmus or Indonesian regulatory announcements.
Check whether the credit-support element appears as guarantees or commitments in NVIDIA's filed disclosures, which would indicate financial exposure.
